segments.say: White plays rook e8, check. The king is stuck behind its own pawns. Is it checkmate?
segments.caption: Checkmate... right?

segments.say: No! The knight jumps back to f8 and blocks the check.
Before you celebrate, check every block and every capture. That's how won games get thrown away.
segments.caption: Check blocks AND captures

segments.say: Did you spot the knight? Comment yes or no.
segments.caption: Did you spot it?
